I will farm this bean plot much like last season, with a few careful inputs where I know they pay. On my side here, beans do better when I keep the field clean and spray against insects, but I will not spend too much cash on fertilizer because this is still a legume plot and the rain is what decides many things. I own this land, so I will also carry some manure to it, and if I can get a good seed from the dealer in time, I will plant that instead of keeping everything local.
